SHOT: A worn photograph, square to camera: the necklace at the base of the throat lying flat on the collarbones, centred. 4:5 vertical, full bleed.

CROP: The frame is cut straight across just ABOVE THE UPPER LIP. NO eyes, NO eyebrows, NO forehead anywhere in this picture. Inside the frame: chin, neck, collarbones, shoulders and upper chest.

THE PRODUCT: IMAGE 1 is the supplier photograph and the ONLY authority on what this piece is: copy its construction, its metal colour and its stone colour EXACTLY; it is worn by a woman in a white top: ignore her, her top and her skin, and take only the necklace. The photo is small and soft: the drop that reads white is a CLEAR faceted cubic zirconia teardrop, not a pearl. IMAGE 2 is our approved packshot of this exact piece: the authority on its size, proportions, metal colour and finish; the piece in this picture must match it exactly. IMAGE 3 is the authority on the model, skin, garment, hair, ground and light: match it exactly, but she wears ONLY the piece from IMAGE 1, worn around the neck; any other jewellery in IMAGE 3 is removed.

THE PLATE: A young Indian woman, late twenties, warm mid-brown skin with golden undertones. Long dark brown hair in loose natural waves. Bare shoulders, marigold-saffron silk camisole with narrow spaghetti straps. Nails short, bare, pale nude, no polish colour. Warm cream seamless with a gentle gradient falloff, never sand, tan, beige or golden. Soft large key from camera-left, one soft shadow.

CONSTRUCTION LOCK: A FINE HERRINGBONE TEARDROP NECKLACE: a NARROW flat polished gold herringbone chain about 2mm wide, stiff, so it lies in smooth straight runs with clean bends, never in soft folds; at the centre front ONE clear PEAR-cut faceted stone, about 8x12mm, hanging POINT UP like a falling drop of water: its narrow pointed tip at the TOP, joined to a tiny gold bail on the chain, and its round full end at the BOTTOM, held in fine gold claws. Next to the teardrop the chain reads as a fine bright line, only about one fifth of the teardrop's width. The drop is a clear, faceted, sparkling stone, NEVER a pearl, never white or opaque, never a round bead; it hangs point UP, never upside down with its wide end at the top, never a shield or heart shape; one drop only; the chain is a narrow 2mm herringbone, never a wide flat ribbon, never as wide as the bail, never a rope, curb or cable.

SCALE TEST: Worn, the fine chain lies flat and smooth on the collarbones like a thin bright line, and the clear teardrop, about the size of a fingernail, hangs point up just below the hollow of the throat. The jewellery keeps its true small size against the body; it is read by bringing the camera closer, never by making the piece bigger.

ABSENCE LIST: No eyes, no eyebrows, no forehead. No second piece of jewellery, no watch, no other rings, no other earrings, no necklace unless it is the product. No nail polish colour. No props, no flowers. Metal: warm 18k gold tone, never brassy, orange or greenish. No lettering, no watermark, no logo, no tag, no size sticker anywhere in frame. No border, no frame, no paper edge, no vignette: the image fills the whole frame edge to edge. A clean modern digital photograph: no creases, no fold lines, no aged-paper texture, no scratches, no film grain.
